parsed.explanation: Combined regime imposes a tier-1 universal exposure: state facilities must match birth-certificate sex, marker changes are banned, and ID checks were enforced within days, while national passports are issued only as M/F by birth sex and entry cables direct refusal and possible fraud inquiry on document discrepancy. No routine sweeps, registration, imprisonment or execution pathway is documented, and courts/advocacy remain operative. Compounding state bans on minor care, school deadnaming, and absence of statewide anti-discrimination/hate-crime coverage, plus documented custodial abuse if detained, pull well below protective jurisdictions.

entry_documents.exposure: National passports stopped X and non-birth-sex markers in 2025, upheld Nov 2025; trans travellers reported confiscation/blocking. Entry cable directs refusal where documents cast reasonable doubt on sex and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility if wilful misrepresentation is material, though never automatic.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; passport suit and challenges to executive orders unresolved, several orders enjoined. Airlines/governments issued advisories, indicating contestation.
entry_documents.interaction: National birth-sex passport aligns with state birth-certificate facility rule, so a mismatch between presentation and documents can trigger secondary screening, refusal, then state facility/custody exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: State prison restrooms must match birth certificate; cell assignment not governed by companion statute, status uncertain. National corrections adopted hair-cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution from 2026; immigration custody reports of trans men forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse. State prison denied gender-confirmation surgery, courts affirmed.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No documented automatic arrest for bathroom use in this state; national hate-crime and employment rulings remain citable. Courts dismissed state's immunity defences before ruling against claimant, showing some judicial review.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry fraud inquiry or facility trespass allegation could lead to detention where birth-sex placement and reported custodial harm become operative; no documented visitor detention in this state.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Effective 4 Dec 2025, restrooms in schools, universities, prisons and state buildings must match birth-certificate sex; facilities fined $25,000/$125,000. Troopers checked ID at women's restrooms outside capitol 6 Dec 2025. National order also bars trans people from government-funded facilities congruent with identity.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Trans women holding female ID markers were admitted in that check. 29 states plus capital district nationally have no mapped ban, and capital city council sought to circumvent intent, but state law governs state buildings.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Unclear guidelines produced uneven invasive enforcement; national facility bar compounds state bar in federally funded buildings, leaving no identity-congruent option in government spaces.

care_services.exposure: Minor gender-affirming care banned since June 2023; national orders and proposed rules restrict care under 18 and public funding. Adult prison surgery denial affirmed. No documented adult visitor hormone-continuity denial in community clinics.
care_services.protection: Temporary injunctions blocked family-investigation directives; several national orders challenged/enjoined. No statewide adult care ban documented.
care_services.interaction: A travelling minor needing medication or referral faces state ban and possible provider/guardian investigation, even if adult companion is not the regulated party; adult emergency care status not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: May 2025 definition act defines sex by ova/fertilization capacity, bans marker changes on licences/birth certificates, requires binary selection. Governor directed agencies to recognise only two genders. National counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; DOJ escalated school-district bathroom investigation.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 2020 national employment ruling prohibits gender-identity employment discrimination; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity. Courts enjoined some orders.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State definition applies across statutes, converting national binary framework into operative document and facility checks by state troopers and school officials.

minors_guardians.exposure: Parental-rights law effective June 2025 bans discussing gender identity in schools, bans LGBT clubs, mandates deadnaming/misgendering. Minor care banned; national order directs criminal investigation of teachers facilitating social transition. Enrolling a visiting minor would expose them to birth-certificate placement and mandated outing.
minors_guardians.protection: Injunctions blocked earlier mandatory-investigation directives; five district attorneys refused them. Short-stay visitor not enrolling in school mitigates some exposure, but care access remains restricted.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor could face school or provider inquiry, records demands, and separation of child from care; adult-only visitor does not face school-placement rule.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime law does not cover gender identity, prosecutions under sexual-orientation enhancement rare, no statewide anti-discrimination law as of 2021. 44 killings nationally attributed in dossier to this state over 2008-2025 at 7.6 per 100k/year, but deliberately not counted due to no background-rate comparison; treated as not established as exceptional trans-specific rate.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; several cities prohibit gender-identity discrimination. No documented police sweeps or organised targeting of visitors in this state.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Absence of state recourse means street harassment in state buildings/schools has thinner remedy, while national statute and city ordinances provide partial, non-state-level recourse.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Remedies are partial: no statewide anti-discrimination law, hate-crime gap, school-district investigation outcome unsourced, guidance for bathroom enforcement unclear, renewal of previously changed markers unsourced, cell placement unsourced. July 2026 assessment places state in top Do Not Travel tier.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Functioning courts, civil-liberties litigation, injunctions, and city protections documented; DOJ investigation shows federal scrutiny of restrictive district, not a remedy for visitors.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Paper national protections do not cancel operative state facility/document rules; efficiency of state enforcement (ID checks, records demands) is exposure, not mitigation, where it enforces the ban.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower severity than 0.15-C: no street sweeps, coerced confessions, beatings as routine, capital clause, or illusory courts. Custodial abuse is documented nationally if detained, but no documented visitor pathway to prolonged violent detention or execution in this state.

Similar universal exclusion without effective remedy in government facilities, but higher than 0.35-A because exclusion is facility/document-based, not a border register with routine denial, ticket seizure and airline verification, and imprisonment is not a typical outcome.

Very similar to 0.45-B: birth-certificate facility rule, minor care limited, bureaucratic mismatch and remedies largely after-the-fact. Slightly lower because definition act, national passport restriction, entry fraud inquiry and custodial reports compound the exposure.

Far below 0.85-A: that anchor has equality law covering services, chosen-name documents, independent oversight and discipline. Here state law explicitly bans marker changes, requires birth-certificate facilities, and lacks statewide anti-discrimination and gender-identity hate-crime coverage.

parsed.synthesis: Operative interaction is document-to-facility: birth-sex national passport and state birth-certificate ban converge, ID checks enforce exclusion in schools, universities, prisons and government buildings, and discrepancy at entry can escalate to refusal/fraud consideration. No organised targeting or likely imprisonment keeps score above 0.35, but tier-1 universal facility exposure, compounding minor-care/school rules, no state recourse, and severe custodial harm if detained keep it at 0.41, materially below 0.55 bureaucratic-friction cases.
